metadata.dataNote: Ward geometry and civic names come from the cited GBA layer. Property type, zoning, height, HAL review, pressure score, and agent outputs are sample frontend data to be replaced with official rules and ingested council records.

propertyTypes.label: Mixed-use
propertyTypes.description: Retail, office, and housing mixed along active corridors.

propertyTypes.label: Commercial
propertyTypes.description: Market, office, institutional, and high-footfall business areas.

propertyTypes.label: Industrial
propertyTypes.description: Production, warehousing, logistics, and heavier employment uses.

propertyTypes.label: Public / Institutional
propertyTypes.description: Civic, airport, park, transport, education, and public-use zones.

zoningClasses.label: Neighborhood residential
zoningClasses.planningNote: Use for localized amenity, road width, parking, and school-load review.

zoningClasses.label: Transit corridor mixed-use
zoningClasses.planningNote: Use for FAR, shadow, traffic, and displacement scenario comparison.

zoningClasses.label: Commercial activity district
zoningClasses.planningNote: Use for pedestrian capacity, deliveries, waste, and late-hour activity review.

zoningClasses.label: Employment / industrial
zoningClasses.planningNote: Use for truck routing, buffers, emissions, and labor access review.

zoningClasses.label: Public and institutional
zoningClasses.planningNote: Use for public access, safety, universal access, and service continuity review.

agentPipelines.label: Zoning Law Parser
agentPipelines.output: Policy constraints by ward and parcel class
